Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 21  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error by concluding the director Larry Kent's birthplace as "Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada," when the correct information ("Johannesburg, South Africa") was explicitly stated on the Larry Kent (filmmaker) Wikipedia page. This mistake occurred due to misinterpretation of the data retrieved by WebSurfer in Step 20. The Planner incorrectly processed "Born: Johannesburg, South Africa" as "Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada," despite both pieces of information being mentioned in the same section of the Wikipedia page (Johannesburg as his birthplace and Vancouver as his location after emigrating). The error aligns with the pattern of **misinterpretation of source data** and a failure to properly reconcile biographical details.
